Feet stay extended down to their original standing baseline, not tucked; this pose will be animated as a jump. Preserve the reference's square canvas, BODY SCALE and BODY LOCATION; do not zoom in or fit bird to extended wings. Keep head, crest, wings and toes fully within safe canvas margins.
